escalationPlan.description: Noah tries to retrieve the ball, but it is stuck flat against a low play wall. Eyes widen.
Noah pulls with both hands; the wall flexes into a shallow curve while the ball stays stuck.
Noah pushes sideways instead; the flexible wall bends underneath the ball and blocks the next reach.
Noah holds the wall steady with a shoulder and changes the pull direction upward; the ball finally releases.
The ball rebounds onto the cheek and sticks there; the cheek stretches with the next broad pull instead of the wall.
